Traffic Diversions Announced Near IIIT Junction for Flyover Construction

Traffic diversions and curbs will be implemented near the IIIT Junction starting July 1. These measures are being put in place to facilitate ongoing flyover construction work. Commuters are advised to expect disruptions and plan their journeys accordingly.
